name: Central Park Play Space
description: Plymouth's biggest park play space, refitted with trampolines, hammocks and a double zip wire. It has three areas: two fenced areas for toddlers with sand and water play, and an open area with a big climbing and sliding structure, trampolines, hammocks, a low ropes course and the zip wire. The council says it suits children of all ages and abilities. The park is open 24 hours and free.
